summary: Fresh G000012 recovery independently reached a real browser-network capability boundary. Representative Chromium and Playwright are installed and launch successfully, but Chromium navigation to the exact V11 GitHub Pages URL is blocked before page load with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR in both desktop and mobile contexts. The public web-reader surface also cannot access that exact URL. Current gh-pages artifacts were reopened to separate deployment/source truth from runtime execution: the candidate directory, static preview manifest, project-context projection and compiled stats projection exist, mobile CSS remains present, stats fail closed to unknown/stale semantics, and ingress only reports queued when durable transport evidence is valid. No served/browser PASS, authenticated transport PASS or fresh-worker wake PASS is claimed.

tests.name: representative_javascript_browser_binary
tests.detail: Chromium resolved at /usr/bin/chromium; Python Playwright is installed and Chromium launched headless successfully.

tests.name: browser_network_navigation_to_github_pages_desktop
tests.detail: Playwright Chromium page.goto('https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/current-tree/control-v11/') failed before DOMContentLoaded with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR at viewport 1440x1000.

tests.name: browser_network_navigation_to_github_pages_mobile
tests.detail: Fresh mobile browser context at 390x844 failed on the same exact URL with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR before page load.

tests.name: public_page_reader_fallback
tests.detail: Independent public-page reader reported the exact GitHub Pages URL inaccessible; even if reachable this reader would not satisfy representative JavaScript execution.

tests.name: served_branch_candidate_presence
tests.detail: gh-pages contains current-tree/control-v11 including index.html, config-v1.js, v11.css, ingress-v1.js, stats-adapter-v1.js and previews/. This proves branch materialization, not end-to-end HTTP/browser execution.

tests.name: source_mobile_contract
tests.detail: gh-pages v11.css retains @media(max-width:679px), one-column command composition, 16px command input and 44px minimum send target.

tests.name: source_static_preview_projection
tests.detail: gh-pages preview manifest uses prometeo.static-preview-manifest/v1 and records 8 AVAILABLE static previews checked_at 2026-09-29T03:12:35Z. The timestamp is historical and is not promoted to fresh served-browser evidence.

tests.name: project_context_projection
tests.detail: Configured projectContextUrl resolves in gh-pages repository bytes to coordination/project-context-v1/INDEX.json, a NON_AUTHORITATIVE_PROJECTION containing 10 projects. Browser consumption remains unexecuted.

tests.name: stats_truthfulness_projection
tests.detail: Configured statsUrl exists in gh-pages with authority OBSERVABILITY_ONLY; stats-adapter-v1.js maps missing/unobserved data to unknown and explicit stale/last-good metadata to stale rather than fabricating zero/live values.

tests.name: ingress_fail_closed_contract
tests.detail: gh-pages ingress-v1.js requires a valid durable ref plus expected result schema before queued=true can survive normalization; missing workspace auth returns boundary with queued=false. Authenticated transport itself was not exercised.

It neither certifies nor rejects current GitHub Pages runtime behavior, does not claim authenticated transport or worker wake, and does not promote V11.
